title: Live-answer reliability cross-check freeze (v62 ordered item 2d)

freeze_history.note: Initial freeze. Hypothesis and freeze record committed to the evaluation namespace before the instrument is executed. No gate, control, quantity, tolerance or exit code may change after this point.

tolerances.float_metrics_rationale: The product publishes stability_jaccard_min rounded to 6 decimal places (0.666667). Every other float metric is published at full Python float precision and is compared exactly (tolerance 0.0 is applied implicitly by the 1e-6 band which is far below any real divergence).

exit_contract.0: ANSWER_RELIABILITY_CROSSCHECK_PASSES — every comparable quantity matches and the product claim boolean is honest
exit_contract.1: ANSWER_RELIABILITY_CROSSCHECK_DIVERGES — a comparable quantity diverges, the product claim is dishonest, or a control failed
exit_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS — pins or inputs absent; never a product verdict

frozen_bars_rehash.note: This instrument does NOT consume these bars. They are recorded here only so the standing freeze-first discipline is visible in the same artifact.

claim_ceiling: Cross-check of the product-owned live-answer reliability measurement only. No frozen bar is scored, no serve recommendation is issued, admission stays fail-closed, human_gate_ready stays false. Zero network. No universal-174k benchmark.
